title: Special Angles
text: Special angles are: 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90° - we know the exact trigonometric values for these.

title: Finding the Combination
text: We need two special angles that add up to 75°. Try different combinations:\n- 30° + 45° = 75° ✓\n- 60° + 15° = 75° (but 15° is not a special angle)

title: Confirm the Answer
text: $$75° = 45° + 30°$$\n\nBoth 45° and 30° are special angles with known exact values.
